title: JPM26: Astellas CEO resists 'rescue BD' as $6B Xtandi patent cliff nears
summary: With Xtandi set to lose U.S. patent protection next year, Astellas’ CEO fielded questions this week about his company’s dealmaking strategy ahead of the loss. Despite continuing to hunt for external innovation, helmsman Naoki Okamura does not want Astellas to make acquisitions for the sole purpose of preventing a revenue decline.
